//: Repository-root config, read by Vercel ONLY while the project's Root Directory is unset. That is the state that produces 'No Next.js version detected': Vercel builds this directory, and this package.json has no next in it. Until Root Directory is set to frontend (scripts/vercel-ci-setup.mjs, or the dashboard), this file turns those doomed Git builds into a clean skip instead of a failure email on every push.
